diffs.patch:
Index: server/docker-compose.dev.yaml
===================================================================
--- server/docker-compose.dev.yaml	
+++ server/docker-compose.dev.yaml	
@@ -1,165 +1,183 @@
 version: '3.8'
 
 services: 
   database: 
     image: postgres:18-alpine
     environment:
       POSTGRES_USER: postgres
       POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
       POSTGRES_DB: wave_db
     ports:
       - "5432:5432"
     volumes:
       - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql
     healthcheck:
       test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres"]
       interval: 10s
       timeout: 5s
       retries: 5
 
   backend-server:
     build: .
     command: node --import tsx src/index.ts
     env_file:
       - src/.env.development
     environment:
       DATABASE_URL: REDACTED
     expose:
       - "3000"
     depends_on:
       database:
         condition: service_healthy  
     profiles: [backend]
 
   auth-service:
     build: .
     command: node --import tsx src/index.ts
     env_file:
       - src/.env.development
     environment:
       DATABASE_URL: REDACTED
     ports:
       - "3003:3000"
     depends_on:
       database:
         condition: service_healthy  
     profiles: [devops]
   
   user-service:
     build: .
     command: node --import tsx src/index.ts
     env_file:
       - src/.env.development
     environment:
       DATABASE_URL: REDACTED
     ports:
       - "3002:3000"
     depends_on:
       database:
         condition: service_healthy  
     profiles: [devops]
 
   redpanda:
     image: docker.redpanda.com/redpandadata/redpanda:latest
     container_name: redpanda
     command:
       - redpanda
       - start
       - --kafka-addr
       - PLAINTEXT://0.0.0.0:29092,OUTSIDE://0.0.0.0:9092
       - --advertise-kafka-addr
       - PLAINTEXT://redpanda:29092,OUTSIDE://localhost:9092
       - --node-id
       - "1"
     ports:
       - "9092:9092"
       - "29092:29092"
     healthcheck:
       test: ["CMD-SHELL", "rpk cluster info"]
       interval: 10s
       timeout: 5s
       retries: 5
     environment:
       REDPANDA_AUTO_CREATE_TOPICS_ENABLED: "true"
 
   mailhog:
     image: mailhog/mailhog:latest
     container_name: mailhog
     ports:
       - "1025:1025"
       - "8025:8025"
     healthcheck:
       test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8025"]
       interval: 10s
       timeout: 5s
       retries: 5
     profiles: [devops]
 
   wallet-service:
     build: .
     command: node --import tsx src/index.ts
     env_file:
       - src/.env.development
     environment:
       DATABASE_URL: REDACTED
       KAFKA_BROKER_URL: redpanda:29092
       EMAIL_HOST: mailhog
       EMAIL_PORT: 1025
     ports:
       - "3001:3000"
     depends_on:
       database:
         condition: service_healthy
       redpanda:
         condition: service_healthy
       mailhog:
         condition: service_healthy
       dragonfly:
         condition: service_healthy
     profiles: [devops]
 
   dragonfly:
     image: dragonflydb/dragonfly:latest
     container_name: dragonfly
     ports:
       - "6379:6379"
     healthcheck:
       test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "-h", "localhost", "-p", "6379", "ping"]
       interval: 10s
       timeout: 5s
       retries: 5
     profiles: [devops]
 
+  tigerbeetle:
+    image: ghcr.io/tigerbeetle/tigerbeetle:latest
+    container_name: tigerbeetle
+    command:
+      - start
+      - --addresses=0.0.0.0:4343
+      - /data/tigerbeetle
+    ports:
+      - "4343:4343"
+    volumes:
+      - tigerbeetle_data:/data
+    healthcheck:
+      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "kill -0 $$(pidof tigerbeetle) 2>/dev/null || exit 1"]
+      interval: 10s
+      timeout: 5s
+      retries: 5
+
   notification-service:
     build: .
     command: node --import tsx src/notification-service.ts
     env_file:
       - src/.env.development
     environment:
       DATABASE_URL: REDACTED
       KAFKA_BROKER_URL: redpanda:29092
       EMAIL_HOST: mailhog
       EMAIL_PORT: 1025
     depends_on:
       database:
         condition: service_healthy
       redpanda:
         condition: service_healthy
       mailhog:
         condition: service_healthy
     profiles: [devops]
 
   nginx:
     image: nginx:1.27-alpine
     depends_on:
       - auth-service
       - wallet-service
       - user-service
     ports:
       - "3000:80"
     volumes:
       - ./nginx/default.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
     profiles: [devops]
 
 volumes:
   postgres_data:
+  tigerbeetle_data:

Looking at the file, services without profiles run by default. I'll add tigerbeetle. I need to figure out a good configuration. TigerBeetle typically uses port 3000 internally, but we already have port 3000 used by nginx. Let me use port 4343 (the default TigerBeetle port for clients).

Let me check if there's a tigerbeetle Docker image available. The standard one is `ghcr.io/tigerbeetle/tigerbeetle` or `tigerbeetle/tigerbeetle`.

I'll add it as a service without profiles, similar to how redpanda is set up.
